sentences.en: Do you know a good specialty store dealing in herbs?
sentences.zh: 你知道有没有卖草药的好店吗？

sentences.en: My specialty is being right when other people are wrong.
sentences.zh: 我的专长就是在别人错的时候对。

sentences.en: You know that I now have made hijacking my specialty.
sentences.zh: 现在劫持已经成为我的拿手好戏了。

senses.zh: 专业；专长特制品，特产，名产特性，特征；特殊性盖印的契约
